name: @switchback/db

scripts.push: dotenv -e ../../.env -- prisma db push --skip-generate && npm run spatial

//devDependencies: @switchback/geo is used only by scripts/seed.ts, for quadkey maths. The runtime db package does not depend on geo and must not — geo already imports core, and db importing geo at runtime is the first half of a cycle.
//devDependencies-ingest: @switchback/ingest is used only by scripts/backfill-peak-elevations.ts, for the Overpass client and parseEleM — reusing the queue, backoff, mirror failover and breaker the public instances require, rather than hand-rolling a second client that obeys none of them. It does close a loop, since ingest depends on db, but only through a script: nothing under packages/db/src imports it, npm links both as workspaces, and the alternative is a copy of the etiquette that drifts.
